subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Environmental Compliance
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Environmental Compliance.

hook.text: A supplier dumps chemicals into a river to cut costs. Your brand name appears in the news. You're implicated.

buildup.text: Environmental compliance means ensuring suppliers meet pollution, waste, and emissions regulations.

discovery.text: Regulations like REACH and RoHS restrict hazardous substances in products sold in Europe.

twist.text: A supplier's violation becomes your problem. Customers and regulators hold brands accountable for their chain.

climax.text: Procurement teams now include environmental criteria in supplier scorecards as a standard practice.

punchline.text: Your supplier's pollution is your brand's reputation.

quiz.question: Why should buyers care about supplier environmental compliance?
